entries.title: Make runs outside the build directory
entries.root_cause: The workflow runs make from the repository root, but the requested target is in the tools/gantry Makefile. Set the step working directory to tools/gantry.

entries.title: Misspelled make target
entries.root_cause: The workflow invokes the nonexistent target verify-bundel instead of verify-bundle in the tools/gantry Makefile. Correct the target spelling.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Make is run in the correct directory and finds the Makefile, but the requested target is misspelled.

entries.title: Make runs outside the build directory
entries.root_cause: The workflow runs make from the repository root, but the requested target is in the tools/gantry Makefile. Set the step working directory to tools/gantry.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a newer runner and a different make target after checkout; the step still starts in the repository root.

entries.title: Bundle manifest check fails
entries.root_cause: The generated bundle manifest omits the required index entry, causing the manifest validation script to fail. Correct the bundle manifest generation.
